Guidance & outlook: So, we have -- we may not be able to, you know, give the complete detail from a broadly standpoint if you have to see, we have been growing at almost say 15% kind of a rate, that is what the expectation is that we will be growing at around 15%.
So, from an EBITDA level what we see that we can expect it to grow around 13% to 14% in the upcoming 2 years to 3 years.
And we are expecting EBITDA to be somewhere around 12% to 13% is what the expectation is.
Growth & demand: GSP Crop Science Limited August 12, 2026 Strong innovation pipeline, us we have more than 100 patent already granted product, and also, we have applied more than 100 applications under process.

Within our domestic business if you have to see as Bhavesh sir just mentioned, our focus on the patented portfolio, we are seeing good growth in the volumes of the products that we have GSP Crop Science Limited August 12, 2026 recently launched like PCT 410 and the products like Fighter who are gaining good scales and good volumes.
Because in a market like India where, you know, we have good manufacturing base also, we see that any market share from a company our size it is easier for us to scale to say 7% to 8% market share.
Margins & costs: Then on the cost part if we see, there has been an increase in the employee cost which is due to the annual increments impact of the wage and the increased slight increase in the head count also.
The overall EBITDA if we see has stood at around 11%.

But from a margin perspective, at a gross level whatever increase that we are seeing in the margins, gross margins, that is mainly supported due to the increase of the share of patented products into B2C business and also good margins in the B2B business wherein we are seeing this overall growth of the percentage points that we are seeing.
Capex & expansion: We are a research-driven agrochemical company specializing in the development and manufacturing of insecticides, herbicides, and fungicides, also plant PGR in India.
So, the current technical capacity utilization is around 70% to 75%, wherein we have some scope to grow the technical base.

Formulation plants, the utilization of formulation plant is around 25% to 30%, but formulation plant typically is not a bottleneck because it is a simpler process, there is no chemical synthesis or reactions that take place, so which also could be outsourced.
Balance sheet & cash: This upgrade is majorly due to the repayment of borrowing from our IPO and the continued good performance of the company.
Risks & challenges: Overall, the financial performance in Q1 FY27 was stable, especially considering the volatile operations environments.

During the quarter, if we see that the global geopolitical developments and climate related risk and certain volatility, there are certain supply chain disruptions and certain anticipations from the customer where due to pricing there were certain holdback of demands that we had seen.

So, the delay -- there was we have seen that there is a delay GSP Crop Science Limited August 12, 2026 in terms of their buying patterns and once they delay it, then what happens is then then timing in terms of reaching the material to them becomes very important.

So in FY26, we've done almost 20% from these patented products.

Currently, it will be difficult fo r us to share, but broadly, th e growth rate th at we've been experiencing since last 3 years, we're expecting that this or at least higher growth rate by another 5%-7% is what we're targeting for the upcoming 3 years.
Growth & demand: So any new product where which is going off patent in future also, so we are planning before five years to make this product viable and from basic raw material.
And with the support of this all vertical and patented thing, in future also our growth will be good and it will be sustainable growth.

Now, this product has been a blockbuster product for us wherein we are seeing that in the span of 2 to 3 years, we have scaled up the volumes of this business to almost INR50 crores to INR70 crores for this particular brand.
Margins & costs: And in this revenue, if we see, INR1,114 crores to be precise, and this INR1,114 crores, we have done an EBITDA of INR153 crores.
This INR153 crores EBITDA is an increase of 32% from last year and this has resulted into a PAT of INR75 crores this year, which was INR59.6 crores last year.

So to give you an example, if say generic product is having a margin of say 35% to 40%, we are talking about gross profit margins from material consumed, then the patented product will be having say around 55% to 60% margins.
Capex & expansion: So in particular manufacturing, we have two technical plants and one is for intermediate plant.
It is a more simpler plant where in no chemical reaction happen.
The technical plants that we have which is one at near Ahmedabad and the biggest plant which is at Nandeshari, there the capacity utilizations are in the range of 70% to 75%.
Risks & challenges: So we are not seeing much challenges because of this El Nino effect.

In terms of supply, as you said, you know, there's no supply disruption per se wherein our production is currently getting impacted, but there are certain delays due to this shipping and logistics issue.
Assurance becomes an important point while, you know, we are discussing about such uncertainties.
